name: StartupKit (Kit)
summary: StartupKit (startupkit.app), branded Kit, is a per-seat SaaS that runs hiring, security/VDP, training, performance reviews, outreach and compensation research for teams where none is a full-time job. Its Hiring module is exposed to AI assistants two ways: an in-app agent and a remote MCP server at /api/v1/mcp (OAuth), whose write tools create a draft job posting from a brief and move a pipeline, always acting as the connected user and never beyond that user's own permissions. A separate no-auth docs/catalog MCP at /mcp is read-only. $8/seat/month, 30-day trial.

agentAccess.notes: The hiring tools are a remote MCP at https://startupkit.app/api/v1/mcp reached over OAuth; creating a posting needs a Kit account, Hiring admin, the hiring_write scope and an active subscription. A separate docs/catalog MCP at /mcp answers initialize with no auth and exposes only read-only tools.

payments.notes: A human buys a per-seat subscription (get_plans, read first-hand from the public /mcp on 2026-11-23: 800 USD-cents/seat/month or 8000/year, 30-day trial, also in EUR/GBP/PLN). No agent-settled path; the agent surface is the subscriber's MCP connection, not a machine-payable endpoint.

jobs.summary: hiring_create_job_posting turns a brief into a draft posting (title, body, salary band, stages, credentials), aided by hiring_list_templates and compensation_get_salary_benchmark; created as a draft with an edit URL, no tool publishes it, a human does. No compliance-review claim; not measured.
